unitTitle: The Lion and the Soldier Ants
title: The Lion and the Soldier Ants
subject: English Language
objectives: Read and understand a story about humility

blocks.text: The Lion and the Soldier Ants

blocks.alt: A lion surrounded by soldier ants
blocks.caption: The soldier ants attacked the proud lion.

blocks.md:
The lion claimed that he was the king of all the animals. He took joy in roaring so that all the animals would continue to get afraid of him. The smaller animals and the soldier ants were thinking of what to do with the lion.

'Let us enter his den at night,' the head soldier ant suggested.

'Yes, that is right. We shall teach him a lesson,' answered the mother soldier ant.

'We shall attack him the way we work. Some of you will enter his nostrils, some his ears, some his eyes and others will swarm all over his body. Bite him everywhere until he says that he is no longer the king of all animals. Do you hear me?'

'Yes,' replied the other soldier ants.

On that night, millions of soldier ants attacked the lion and started to bite him fiercely.

The mother soldier ant said, 'Oh Lion. Don't get proud of yourself. If you agree that you are no longer the king of all animals then we will set you free.'

'I am the king of all animals,' the lion roared more and more again.

'Then we shall eat you raw. Children, eat as much of the lion as you like. He is very stubborn,' the mother soldier ant concluded.

'I am still the king of all animals,' the lion continued to groan.

When the soldier ants had eaten off all the flesh in the stomach and back of the lion, the lion cried that he is no longer the king of all the animals. He had only hair on his head. And that is why the lion has a mane.

- A lion **roars**.
- A cat **miaows**.
- A dog **barks**.
- A horse **neighs**.
- An elephant **trumpets**.
- A cock **crows**.
- A hen **cackles**.
- A goat **bleats**.
- A pig **grunts**.
- A frog **croaks**.
- A cow **moos**.
- A sheep **baas**.

quiz.explain: He roared so all animals would be afraid of him.

quiz.q: Who planned the attack on the lion?
quiz.explain: The soldier ants planned to attack the lion at night.

quiz.q: What noise does a lion make?
What noise does a dog make?
Why does the lion have a mane?
options: Because the ants ate the rest of the fur
quiz.explain: The ants ate all the flesh and fur on his back, leaving only hair on his head.
